dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Hey, this looks just like the kind of venue we have in our tribe. You've even got a Dance-Off Stage... Yep, this place is performance ready.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Speaking of the Dance-Off Stage... *sigh* I wonder if I'll ever achieve my dream of being a full-time DJ...

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: If there ever comes a day when I don't have to make ancient names anymore, maybe then I'll finally be free...
